english: The port's almost here!
I doubt they'll let us get there\nthat easily…
Hibiki, you're not going to say anything stupid\nlike trying to talk it out with the black ones again, are you?
Honestly, I do want to talk it out.\nBut we can't let them fire 'Gustave Kai'\nwhile we're at it.
As long as you've got that straight.
But even while fighting, I want to ask.\nWhy they're doing this.
Agreed. World domination or whatever,\nthey've got better things to do!
Better things??? Um… like homework?
Yes, people who do such troublesome things\nshould study harder.
Whatever, but an idiot who doesn't even do homework\ncould never conquer the world.
But if you conquered the world,\nyou could get rid of homework you don't wanna do!\nSome kid might think that?
Ha! That could work…
Hopeless…
But it's precisely because of some strong feeling\nthat people hold dreams and ambitions.
…Father.
And those usually end up\nbeing no good for anyone.
Too-strong feelings breed grudges.\nAnd really, making such a cute girl\nplay phantom thief is just wrong.
Perhaps the world of humans is\nnothing but clashing wills.
(Wills meant to dispel evil wills\nhave also been kept strong and long…\nThe shrine maiden of Seika is one of them…)
Ngh…!!
Hya? What's wrong, Reki-san?\nWhy'd you suddenly shoot the ground…?
I hear… a song…
This song — no way!?
The likes of you!!
Perish!!
Denied!!
Black Symphogears…!!
All lined up, huh. Hibiki!
I'm fine!\nI expected this much!
You know me, so I'll skip introductions —\nI'm Tachibana Hibiki!\nJust one question!
You guys know about Kadingir!\nSo why are you siding with\nthe ones using 'Gustave Kai'?
It's pointless.\nUnderstanding each other is pointless… impossible.
And we know that…
You just don't know it, that's all!!
Hearing that in my own voice, and Tsubasa-san's and Chris-chan's…\nit's a shock…
But! Telling you it's not like that!\nGetting you to understand — that's my fight!!
That fight's pointless… why don't you just quit.
This world isn't worth protecting.
You can't save the world with songs!
Even if words don't reach you,\nI still have these hands — these fists!
Come on, let's talk! With our hearts! And our bodies!
I'll get it across! These feelings!
Hahaha!! I'll smash you to pieces!!
That voice!?
You too! You too! You too!\nI'll smash ALL of you to pieces!!
Black Koto-chan…!
Starting with you!!
Stoooop!!
Your opponent is me!!
Break!!
Hey, why are you screaming about smashing everything?\nI hate being bored, but\nit's not like I enjoy smashing things?
My home's already gone! And yours too!\nI'll smash your home too!!
Huh? Your home's gone?
But still, that doesn't mean\nyou can smash other people's homes!!
Shut up! I'll smash you first!
You're hopeless!\nI won't let you!!
Everyone, be careful!\nThe enemy hits hard!
Don't let our close-combat-weak friends get taken out!\nGot it!
Alright! Let's do this!
I'll smash you with everything from the start!!
You should try to have a little fun —\na little peace of mind matters, you know?
I'll smash that smug relaxed face too!
Let's both avoid the face.\nWe're girls, after all…!
Breeeak!!
Sorry, Koto-chan!\nShe's all yours!
Okay! Hibiki-san, focus\non the Symphogear users!
Humanity's done for!\nJust give up already!
What did you see, what do you know, to say it's over?\nWhat made you decide to give up?
Say that after you win!
You'll tell me if I win… then!
Take my sword of rage!
I don't understand why you're angry at all!\nWon't you tell me why?
My sword is no longer a defender's blade! Come!
That's not Tsubasa-san!\nI can't lose!
Goodbye. You end here!
If you're me,\nyou must want to talk it out!
No matter how many times you come, it's the same!\nWords are meaningless.\nYou get that now, right!
I don't get it at all.
What!?
Everyone taught me\nthat words aren't meaningless.\nBut they're not all-powerful either.
So if words really can't reach you!\nIf they're not enough to carry my feelings!
Like you could beat me!
I didn't come to beat you!
Match decided.
Hehe…!\nYou'll regret not letting me\nsmash you… you too, eventually…!
No regrets! I mean,\nwith all that power,\nwhy use it the wrong way?
THIS much power?\nHa, don't make me laugh at the very end!
Huh? I wasn't trying to be funny…
This happened because I only have\nthis tiny bit of power…
What do you mean?
You'll figure it out soon enough.\nBye-bye.
Ah! Hey!!
She vanished… was she\nnot human after all…?
So strong, yet\nonly this tiny bit of power…?\nWhat does that mean…
Tch, I lost… as promised, I'll tell you.\nWhat I came to know.
Which is?
True despair, and true annihilation.\nAgainst the truly, truly real end,\nresistance is pointless. You'll understand soon.
But, we were still talking…!!
When the end comes, at least let it be with grace…
Why do you give up!?
If you resist, you won't even get to draw the curtain yourself.\nRemember that.
Drawing the curtain yourself —\nwhat meaning is there in that!\nWhat meaning…!
Now!!
These endlessly overflowing feelings!\nWith these hands, our souls connect! All heart!\nGoooooo!!
Guaaahhh!!
With this strike! The feelings in this fist!\nReach her!! Reeeach heeer!!
Ngh!! Uuh…!! Hah!!
I felt it connect…!\nThe trembling of heart and soul, from my fist into her depths…!
Ngh… uuuh!!
Hehe… it reached me. All the way inside…!
Really!?
Yeah… I can tell… that it reached me.
Thank goodness…!
But… I'm sorry…
I'm sorry, but… it's not there…\nIn my 'there,' there's nothing left anymore.
Huh…
I'm sorry… and thank you…
Ah…
Why… it reached her, so why!!
Hibiki, you did well.\nAt the end, she properly tried\nto answer your feelings.
Aria-san…!
But the fact she couldn't answer\nisn't your fault.\nIt's because of something we don't know.
I know how frustrating it feels, though.
Yes…!
What were those people…?\nI just couldn't understand…
What I felt fighting them\nwas a strange fragility of heart.
Right. Somewhere in their hearts they've given up,\ndespaired… that's why they lack\nshrewdness and tenacity.
What do you think, Hibiki-chan?
If it were me, when I took that final blow,\nI think I'd have answered with everything I had.\nBut she couldn't.
There must be a reason\nshe ended up like that. There must be…
I want to find out what it is.
Yes.\nI'm sure it's something\nwe need to know too.
But for now, 'Gustave Kai'\nis the top priority. Let's hurry!
Yes. The port is right there!
Roger!
Right! Then, to lift our spirits!\nHere I gooo!!
Heave-ho!!
Huh? Why a leotard!?
Quick change?
No, there was no undressing motion.
Then what is it!?
Hehe. Secret.\nDream power can do anything.
Dream power? That outfit is from that?
It's been a while since I took this form, but\nI remember it surprisingly well.
That'd be handy when you're about to be late for school!
It would help if you'd just\nwake up a little earlier…
Dream power is amazing!
Because it's a free power.\nAs long as you don't set limits on yourself,\nyou can do all sorts of things.
Now then, let's head to the decisive battle!
She's already changed back!?
Remu, you're really something…
//END
